sentences.en: I have a sore throat, so I can't sing in the choir today.
sentences.zh: 我喉咙痛，所以今天不能去合唱团唱歌了。

sentences.en: The doctor prescribed some lozenges for my sore throat.
sentences.zh: 医生给我开了一些含片治疗喉咙痛。

sentences.en: Sipping hot tea with honey helps relieve a sore throat.
sentences.zh: 喝些蜂蜜热水可以缓解喉咙痛。
